abort.invalid_discovery: The Konzertmeister MCP app sent invalid settings.
abort.set_up_by_app: This integration is set up automatically by the Konzertmeister MCP app. Install and start the app instead.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Konzertmeister MCP app has updated its helper integration to version {version}. Home Assistant must be restarted once to load it. Click Submit to restart now.

api_key.title: Konzertmeister MCP: API key of {name} rejected
api_key.description: Konzertmeister rejects the API key of the association **{name}** – the AI assistant cannot use its Konzertmeister data. Ask a leader of the association for the current key (Konzertmeister web app: association details → Edit → Public API), open **Konzertmeister** in the sidebar and enter it in the card of this association. This notice disappears by itself afterwards.

removal.title: Konzertmeister MCP removed
removal.message: The Konzertmeister MCP app was uninstalled, so its helper integration for remote access removed itself (including its files). Nothing else to do – a restart is not needed.
